title: Bite Mark
description: Draw a white disc with a circular bite taken out of its right side, on a black background. The disc has radius 0.6 and is centered. The bite is a circle of radius 0.4 centered at (0.4, 0.0). Everything inside the bite is black. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: Flipping a distance's sign turns inside into outside. To cut the second circle out of the first, take max() of the first distance and the negated second distance.
